mono.subject: 02-cosmos
mono.title: 宇宙：引力与光的路径
mono.titleEnglish: Gravity and the Paths of Light

phrase.zh: 光的弯曲，显出看不见的引力。

visual.zh: 弧线、球体与弯曲的带状结构，把引力对光传播的影响转化为可观看的空间。它们不是宇宙中的实体轨道，也不是某次观测的精确重建。
visual.en: Arcs, spheres and curved bands turn gravity’s effect on light into a visible space. They are neither physical rails in the universe nor a reconstruction of a particular observation.

background.zh: 爱因斯坦在 1915 年完成广义相对论的关键工作，将引力与时空几何联系起来。质量会影响周围的时空，光的路径也随之改变。常见的弯曲平面只是帮助理解的类比，真实理论描述的是四维时空。
background.en: Einstein completed the crucial work on general relativity in 1915, connecting gravity with the geometry of spacetime. Mass affects the surrounding spacetime and the paths followed by light. A curved surface is a teaching analogy for a theory of four-dimensional spacetime.
